negative_snippets:
recently stayed at this hotel and, unfortunately, it did not meet even the most basic expectations. Here are the main issues I encountered:
​Lack of Ventilation: The room felt extremely stuffy and lacked proper airflow, making it uncomfortable to spend any time in. There were no towels provided in the room upon arrival, which is a basic standard for any hotel.
​Poor Housekeeping: The general cleaning was not up to the mark. The room didn’t feel fresh or well-maintained.
​Overpriced Dining: The food prices are significantly higher than the nearby restaurants. You are better off walking a few minutes down the street for better quality and much fairer prices.
​Between the lack of cleanliness and the high costs, I wouldn't recommend staying here. There are better, more comfortable options in the immediate area.

We booked this hotel through the MakeMyTrip app, reserving two rooms a month in advance. To our surprise, upon arrival we were informed that only one room was available. They offered us another room in an adjacent building, claiming it was part of their property, but the room quality was far below acceptable standards. Basic amenities such as Wi-Fi password, intercom, kettle, and toiletries were provided only after repeated reminders and nearly an hour of waiting.

After this inconvenience, we went to check the room allotted to our parents, where another issue occurred — my mother got locked inside the bathroom due to a faulty door lock. The door had to be broken open as there was no other way to get her out.

We had booked the stay for one night, but the hotel ensured disappointment at every step. We had also requested packed complimentary breakfast the previous evening, to which they had agreed, but the request was not communicated to the next shift. As expected, this too was mishandled.

The hotel’s location felt unsafe, and although it was listed as a 4-star property on MMT, it did not meet even basic 2-star standards. (It appears their ratings may have been artificially boosted.)

Please refer to the photos already shared, which clearly reflect the poor condition. We booked through makemytrip.
-The hotel room had a strong smoking smell, making it uncomfortable and unhealthy.
-No ventilation in the room.
-The room was dirty and poorly maintained.
-The washroom had a persistent foul smell, indicating poor hygiene standards.
- This is nowhere close to what was promised by MakeMyTrip.
